description: Keep the last recording for good in the library, as a .kfrec.json file the dev tools panel can open. record, stop_recording and run_scenario keep each recording automatically (only the newest automatic ones stay): saving one of those keeps that copy instead of writing a second one.

path.description: Default: the library, as <app>-<time>.kfrec.json. A path elsewhere writes a copy there.

name: save_recording
